name: Guangdong Lvtong New Energy Electric Vehicle Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Lvtong New Energy Electric Vehicle Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of electric field vehicles under the LVTONG brand name in China. It offers vehicles, such as electric sightseeing, golf sightseeing, electric antique, electric patrol, electric freight, and electric special vehicles, as well as electric vintage cars, commercial floor scrubbers, and commercial sweepers. The company also offers after-sales services. It exports its products to the European Union, the United States, Canada, Russia, Japan, and South Korea. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Dongguan, China.
